name: fxf_cat_anim
doc: Stands in for saves/cat_anim.state (the owner's capture of the cat in the wake-up cutscene): from the opening's curtain (fxf_loc002_intro_curtain) A every 12 frames through Mom's talk, 877 frames: storyline 0, the cat (obj 9) parked on its held pose before its anime-once and walk, on the reference's timeline: the AB arms 7 frames later and the walk starts at f27, as from the reference (873 frames is the WRAM frame nearest it, but its cat runs 4 frames later).
